articles.title: In Clarity Act's final weeks, its path through U.S. Senate not getting much clearer
articles.snippet: Tough negotiations linger in several difficult arenas, but crypto's Washington lobbyists are flying in allies this week and still hoping for a July vote.

articles.title: Multi-year Bitcoin holder selling falls to 19-month low as halving model flags new market bottom date
articles.snippet: OG Bitcoin holders' spending dropped to a 19-month low, as market cycle indicators point to September as a potential market bottom.

articles.title: Chainlink joins European and Korean bank consortia to develop FX settlement network
articles.snippet: Banks across Europe and South Korea will study whether regulated euro and won stablecoins can enable real-time cross-border foreign exchange settlement.

articles.title: Bitcoin price taps $65.5K as Iran deal sees oil drop toward 16-week low

articles.title: The Studio Behind 'Ex Machina' Is Now Researching AI With Google
